questions.prompt: Which US law ended legal segregation in public accommodations?
questions.fact: The Senate debate included the longest filibuster in that body's history against a civil rights measure.

questions.prompt: What is the term for an animal that eats dead organic matter?
questions.fact: Vultures have stomach acid strong enough to destroy anthrax and botulism, which is why carrion does not kill them.

questions.prompt: Which country hosted the 2020 Summer Olympics, held in 2021?
questions.fact: It was the first Games postponed rather than cancelled, and was held almost entirely without spectators.

questions.prompt: Which musician is known for the song Respect?
questions.fact: The spelling out of the title and the sock-it-to-me refrain were both her additions to the original.

questions.prompt: Which country's territory includes the island of Sicily?
questions.fact: It has its own autonomous statute, granted in 1946 partly to head off a separatist movement.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the novel The Handmaid's Tale's Canadian contemporary, The Stone Angel?
questions.fact: Alice Munro later became the first Canadian to win the Nobel Prize in Literature, in 2013.

questions.prompt: Which company created the Slack competitor Microsoft Teams?
questions.fact: Bundling it with existing office subscriptions triggered a European competition complaint.
